claim_one_line: THE FOUNDING PRINCIPLE READ AS A SELECTION RULE: THE ADVISOR SEAT'S SEALED RUN RE-DERIVED ON MAIN (the owner's confirmed ruling to try it; P-762; data-free, exact integers, exhaustive to 20 letters; the seat's code not run): the seat's result holds entry for entry. Read as 'the least departure no counted level detects', the principle picks the run of 6 alone only when detection means the whole level and only the golden background's own level counts: (6) at 6 letters, the next at 11, the shortest of sign minus at 10 ((2,2,1,5), (3,4,3), (5,1,2,2)). At any single level N -- 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11 -- the same rule picks the single run of N + 1, so the run of 6 comes out because 5 goes in. Under the line reading (6) ties with (2,2,2); counted by extra letters 15 departures tie; with levels 4 and 5 the least is a mirror pair of 17 letters and with levels 2 to 5 a mirror pair of 18 ((2,2,2,2,1,1,4,4) and its reverse); on silver at its own level 8 the single run ties with (1,2,1,2,1,2,1) at 10 letters, and on bronze at 13 four departures of 13 letters beat it. To 12 letters at level 5 the allowed set is 8 departures of sign plus, 9 of sign minus and 77 more that fix the line only. Main adds the line reading on silver and bronze, and that wherever several levels count the least come as a departure and its reverse. The selection criterion stays an input: the rule passes the choice to which sense of detection and which levels count. 0 of 19.
